messages.author: d66aa3feb509150a
messages.subject: Using install_github and roxygen2
parts:
Hello, it seems that to use devtools::install_github to obtain a functioning package install the repository must also have changes in man/ and NAMESPACE that are made by roxygen2::roxygenize() to your package source tree. 

This also means that in order to obtain the built vignettes, the inst/doc/ folder must be pushed as well, after the package is built to a tarball and then untarred (or the equivalent to the standard R CMD workflow). 

I'm confused about the vignette part, since devtools::document and devtools::build make the NAMESPACE and man/*.Rd but the built vignettes end up in the tarball (as per standard R CMD workflow). 

How do committed devtools/github users maintain their mixed source/built projects so that users get a fully-functioning installation with install_github? I see that https://github.com/hadley/lubridate contains the inst/doc/ built files, but it's not clear to me how the build/install workflow results in the mixed source tree. 

I use roxygen2 for the man/ and NAMESPACE, but I prefer to keep those out of GitHub - I can see the need to push them out, but surely the staging/commit process is pretty untidy, and the vignette process escapes me. 

I'd appreciate any pointers to where this is explained or notes on how people build their workflow to suit.

Thanks, Mike
